_how_to_use: List prices and free-tier limits per model. Prices are behind the cost_usd field of runs.jsonl and the list-price column of COSTS.md: most calls ran on a free tier, and for those these numbers say what the same calls cost at list price. A model marked 'paid' has no free tier: its cost was really paid. Each price is copied from the provider's own pricing page on the date in 'checked'. A model with no entry, or with a null price, gives a cost of null (shown as n/a). 'free_tier' holds the limits that apply to this project: the pipeline refuses a request that would go over a daily limit, and waits out a per-minute limit.
_units: per_1m_tokens (usd_in, usd_out; output includes thinking tokens) | per_audio_second (usd_out per second of audio, usd_in per 1M input tokens) | per_512_tile (usd_out per output tile, usd_in per reference image, usd_step per step) | per_gpu_minute (usd per GPU) | 'paid': true marks a model with no free tier, whose cost is really spent

gemini-3.8-flash.note: Paid tier, standard. The page gives these prices through 31 December 2026 and 1.50 / 7.50 from 1 January 2027. This model thinks by default and bills thinking as output, so a call is priced only when its thinking tokens were logged.

Text input is 0.50 USD per 1M tokens and is counted when the response reports input tokens. Prices through 31 December 2026.

claude-opus-5-5.note: No free tier: these calls are paid for from prepaid credit, so their cost_usd is money spent. Output tokens include the model's thinking.

@cf/black-forest-labs/flux-2-klein-4b.note: 0.000287 USD (26.05 neurons) per output 512x512 tile and 0.000059 USD (5.37 neurons) per input 512x512 tile. A 1024x1024 picture is four output tiles. Each reference image is sent smaller than 512x512 and is counted as one input tile. 1,000 neurons cost 0.011 USD, and 10,000 a day are free.

free_tier.source: 10,000 neurons a day at 0.011 USD per 1,000 neurons, reset at 00:00 UTC: https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/platform/pricing/ read on 2026-11-25. The account moved to the Workers Paid plan (5 USD a month) at about 23:50 East Africa Time on 25 Nov: from then on what goes over the daily allowance is billed at this price.

@cf/black-forest-labs/flux-1-schnell.note: 0.0000528 USD (4.80 neurons) per 512x512 tile plus 0.0001056 USD (9.60 neurons) per step.

free_tier.source: 10,000 neurons a day at 0.011 USD per 1,000 neurons, reset at 00:00 UTC: https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/platform/pricing/ read on 2026-11-25

kaggle_gpu.source: https://cloud.google.com/products/compute/gpus-pricing : NVIDIA T4, 16 GB, 0.35 USD per GPU per hour on demand in Iowa (us-central1). 0.35 / 60 = 0.005833 per GPU minute
kaggle_gpu.note: Kaggle's GPUs are free. This is what one rented T4 costs, as a reference. It is the GPU alone: the page says each GPU adds to the cost of the machine it is attached to. Lines logged before this price was read keep a null cost in the log, and the cost table prices them from their GPU minutes.

addis-voices-2.note: Addis AI, Addis Voices 2. The pricing page gives 0.032 USD per generated minute as an indicative price, and the documentation 5 ETB per generated minute: 0.000533 USD per second. Pay as you go. A new account starts with a sign-up credit of 3.17 USD and no card. No daily limit on requests is stated.
